widgets.logged_out_text: No Google account connected yet — click Connect Google Account below.

widgets.value: ### Connect your Google account Connect Google Account → On a workspace linked to the cloud, this is all you need — click, sign in, done. No OAuth client to create. If this workspace is **not** cloud-linked, save your own client in **Advanced** below first. Use this to (re)authorize, add another account, or recover from an expired/revoked token — no agent needed. Landed on a dead tab instead? See below. Tokens live in `$AW_WORKSPACE_HOME/data/google-workspace-mcp/credentials/` and survive an app reinstall.

widgets.title: Consent redirect landed on a dead tab?

widgets.value: Only happens with your own OAuth client (Advanced below): a Google **Desktop app** client can only redirect to `localhost`, which from your browser means *your own machine*, not this container. If clicking Connect above ends on a tab that fails to load, the authorization code is still sitting in that tab's address bar. Copy the whole URL and paste it here to finish signing in.

fields.label: Redirect URL from the dead tab
fields.description: Host and port are ignored — only the code/state query string matters.

widgets.title: Advanced: bring your own Google OAuth client

widgets.value:
Only needed if this workspace is **not** linked to the cloud — a cloud-linked workspace connects with the button above, no client to create here.

The values ported from agentic-workspace are the **Workspace MCP** *Desktop app* client in the `crispal` Google Cloud project. Desktop clients accept any `localhost` redirect, which is what this server's callback uses — a Web client would need its exact callback URL registered in Google Cloud first.

The secret is stored in the zero-knowledge secret store, never in plain config.

**Or import an existing token** — if this account was already authorized in agentic-workspace, copy its `<email>.json` from that host's `.tmp/google_workspace_mcp_credentials/` and POST it to `/api/apps/google-workspace-mcp/credentials` with `{"email": "…", "credentials": {…}}`. No consent screen, no browser.

fields.label: OAuth client ID
fields.description: Not a credential on its own — also visible in this app's Settings.

fields.label: OAuth client secret
fields.description: Leave blank to keep the secret already saved.

widgets.value:
### Server
`workspace-mcp` runs in its own private venv — never the workspace's shared one, whose `starlette`/`cryptography`/`mcp` versions it would otherwise upgrade under every other Python MCP server. Reinstall it after changing `pin_version` in Settings.
